scope: One subdivision-2 Earth-radius reference at 1 m initial active depth, ten years at each of 900/450-second coupling. annualLakeIdentityAudit.method: Independent report-level difference of consecutive liquid high/low components versus actual annual capture/delivery/evaporation; ordinary binary64 summation, not an exact arithmetic oracle.
